usage.callShape: POST https://x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/embeddings with JSON body {"text":"<string>","model":"text-embedding-3-small"} (use "texts":[...] for batch)
usage.outputShape: body.embedding (flat array of floats, ~1536 dims for text-embedding-3-small). NOT OpenAI shape — there is no body.data[].embedding wrapper.
quirks: The field is 'text' (single string) or 'texts' (array of strings) — NOT the OpenAI 'input' field. Sending {input:...} returns HTTP 400 'Provide text (string) or texts (array of strings)' AND still charges you $0.001.
Response shape is NOT OpenAI-compatible despite the description: result is {embedding:[...]} at the top level, not {data:[{embedding:[...]}]}.
Pay-per-call x402 on Base USDC ($0.001). Also accepts USDm (eip155:4326) and Solana USDC.
model defaults likely work but text-embedding-3-small confirmed; pass 'dimensions' if you need a reduced vector.
usage.guide: Call POST https://x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/embeddings with a JSON body using the key 'text' for a single string (or 'texts' for an array), plus optional 'model' (e.g. text-embedding-3-small) and 'dimensions'. Do NOT use OpenAI's 'input' key — it returns 400 and still charges you. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.001 per call, synchronous. Read the embedding vector directly from body.embedding (a flat float array); it is not wrapped in an OpenAI-style data array.
